notes: τὸν ἀναβάντα πρῶτον ἰχθύν divides under rule 31: the article precedes its expressed head noun and takes 'the', the participle keeps 'that … cometh up' with the preverb particle, and the noun stands bare.
ἵνα μή is one noncompositional unit on 'lest', headed on ἵνα, per rule 39's own example; σκανδαλίσωμεν heads on 'stumble', the meaning-bearing complement of the causative frame (rules 15, 17).
The junctures before 'cast' and 'give' go to the verbs they introduce (rule 88); τό before στόμα is emptied by the possessive on αὐτοῦ (rule 20).
